schema_note: Chapter-local semantic risk set after deterministic validation; excludes ordinary cross-discipline notes whose classifications are not uncertain.

items.title: Five Urology units use only weak canonical MCC evidence
items.summary: Targeted registry searches found no dedicated renal-stone, renal-mass, prostate-cancer, cryptorchidism, or pediatric bladder/bowel dysfunction objective. Each weak citation is explicitly adjacent rather than fabricated and has requires_scope_review=true.
items.recommended_action: Recheck after an MCC registry refresh; retain only recognition, initial investigation, urgent escalation and referral.

items.title: Specialist-detail decisions reviewed
items.summary: Penile tumour staging/treatment, Wilms treatment, endoscopic/definitive procedural technique, and transition-related reconstruction remain out of question scope. Each unit keeps recognition, respectful context or referral only where appropriate.
items.recommended_action: No action unless future MCC objectives add a specific graduating-student competency.

items.title: Urology recommendations requiring current-source verification
items.summary: Medication choices, PSA screening, testosterone thresholds, antimicrobial regimens and transition-care protocols are deliberately not frozen during scope mapping.
items.recommended_action: At question generation, verify exact schedules, thresholds, doses and algorithms against current Canadian guidance.
